step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
  {
    "title": "User ID/User Principal Name",
    "name": "user_id",
    "type": "text",
    "tooltip": "Provide a user ID or userPrincipalName (usually an email address) to pull the email.",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true
  },
  {
    "title": "Folder ID/Path",
    "name": "folder_id",
    "type": "text",
    "tooltip": "Provide folder ID from which you want to pull emails. if you want to pull mails from a nested folder in this case you need to provide folder IDs below format E.g. Parent_folder_id/child_folder_id.",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true
  },
  {
    "title": "Fetch Mail in Last X Minutes",
    "name": "minutes",
    "type": "text",
    "tooltip": "Fetch mails from last X minutes",
    "description": "Fetch mails from last X minutes",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": 10
  },
  {
    "title": "Odata Query",
    "name": "odata_query",
    "type": "text",
    "tooltip": "Provide the OData query which you want to filter the email. Note: The query parameter '$filter' is not supported when using the 'Search' parameter .please refer to connector documents for more details.",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "placeholder": "isRead eq false&$orderby=receivedDateTime desc",
    "value": ""
  },
  {
    "title": "Limit",
    "name": "limit",
    "type": "integer",
    "tooltip": "The number of emails to return in result. Default limit 20",
    "description": "The number of emails to return in result. Default limit 20",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": false
  },
  {
    "title": "Sync Emails to Communication Module",
    "name": "use_communications",
    "type": "checkbox",
"sub_title" : "Check this option to automatically duplicate incoming emails from your inbox into the FortiSOAR Communications Module",
    "tooltip": "Check this option to automatically duplicate incoming emails from your inbox into the FortiSOAR Communications Module. This allows for seamless management and continuation of external email communications directly within the platform.",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "value": true
  }
]
